Guides, tools and teaching materials for reproducible empirical work with R,
Quarto and coding agents.

::: {.ledger}

* [Guide]{.ledger-label} **[Coding agents with GitHub](resources/coding-agents.qmd)**

  How to let an AI agent do the routine work in an R and Quarto project, with a
  file of instructions, one branch per task and a review before anything is
  merged, and what stays with you.

  ::: {.ledger-links}
  [Read the guide](resources/coding-agents.qmd)
  :::

* [Skills]{.ledger-label} **[A third pair of eyes: AI-assisted consistency review of statistical products](https://github.com/valentinklotzbuecher/third-pair-of-eyes)**

* [Talk]{.ledger-label} **[A Third Pair of Eyes? AI-Assisted Review of Statistical Reports and Code](https://github.com/valentinklotzbuecher/scto-ai-review)**

* [Guide]{.ledger-label} **[R and Quarto: a short start](resources/r-quarto.qmd)**

  Why to work as a reproducible pipeline, how to set up a project, the R you
  need first, and how one Quarto file becomes a web page, a Word document, a
  PDF or slides, with a complete example to copy and a reading list.

  ::: {.ledger-links}
  [Read the guide](resources/r-quarto.qmd)
  :::

* [Seminar]{.ledger-label} **[Reproducible Research Pipelines with R and Quarto](teaching/reproducible-research/index.qmd)**

  From my 2024/25 seminar at the University of Freiburg: a first report, one
  source in three formats, maps, slides and a paper template.

  ::: {.ledger-links}
  [See the examples](teaching/reproducible-research/index.qmd)
  :::

* [Template]{.ledger-label} **Quarto thesis template**

  For Bachelor's and Master's theses in economics, set up for the University
  of Freiburg and easy to adapt. Text and R code sit in the same files, and one
  command turns them into a formatted PDF, and a web version, with numbered
  figures, tables and equations, cross-references and a bibliography. A short
  worked chapter shows how each piece is written.

  ::: {.ledger-links}
  [GitHub](https://github.com/valentinklotzbuecher/ufr_thesis) | [Example PDF](https://github.com/valentinklotzbuecher/ufr_thesis/blob/master/_book/FirstnameLastname_thesis.pdf)
  :::

* [Talk]{.ledger-label} **[Synthetic Control Methods](https://github.com/valentinklotzbuecher/jcod)**

:::
